title: Lucknow fire news highlights: 4 arrested in Aliganj fire that killed 15; SIT to submit report in 7 days
description: Lucknow fire news highlights: 15 people were killed after a fire broke out in a three-storey building in Lucknow on Monday. CM Yogi announced ₹5 lakh ex-gratia for the families of the deceased, besides ordering an SIT probe. A preliminary report suggests the blaze may have started in an AC duct
